verdict.rationale: Insomnia documents its own storage-mode controls. Users can convert a project between Local Vault, Cloud Sync and Git Sync, and with Git Sync the project data stays in the user's repository and Insomnia does not host it. Cloud sync is described as unreadable by Insomnia servers. Together these let users decide whether the vendor retains any project data at all. Missing for 10: documented deletion controls (account or cloud data deletion), configurable retention periods, any retention policy for AI-feature inputs, and independent corroboration.
